title: The Weakest Math Students Lost 14 Points
hook: The math gap widened most where students already struggled.
closing: Falling math scores can compound into fewer options for students later.
question: Did your math skills recover?

segments.say: Math scores fell to 271, nearly erasing decades of gains for thirteen-year-olds.
The weakest math students lost 14 points, widening the gap between them and stronger classmates.
Math scores slipped again to 270, showing the lost ground still has not returned.
